extracted.name: Mrs momoiro cocktail
extracted.description: Dry and sweet, this picture-perfect strawberry cocktail is a dream summer drink made with vodka and a dash of absinthe
ingredient_lines: small handful of strawberries hulled and sliced, to garnish
instruction_lines: Fill a wine glass with ice. Pour in the vodka, strawberry liqueur and rosé, shake over two dashes of absinthe and stir well.
Stir in the strawberry slices to garnish, then serve.
